title: Principal eigenvalues of nonlocal operators with advection: sharp scaling limits and spectral phase transitions
summary: We consider generalized principal eigenvalues of one-dimensional nonlocal dispersal operators with a drift of fixed sign. A principal difficulty in this non-self-adjoint setting is the absence of a variational characterization of the principal value. In the symmetric drift-free problem, the critical nonlocal-to-local limit can be treated through a quadratic variational structure and Sobolev-seminorm approximation as Berestycki-Coville-Vo \cite{BCV}. The drift destroys this structure and, on a bounded interval, introduces at the same time a one-sided inflow--outflow boundary geometry.…
